newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - Low volumes mark week.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - Low volumes mark week.

text.p: Domestic institutional investors maintained strong demand over the week, but failed to attract sellers of volume on the Botswana stock exchange.
Turnover was down to 53,395 (70,100) shares, traded for Pula 154,246 (Pula 294,940). The index shed 0.93 points to close at 355.95 points
Gains on the week included Botswana Insurance which rose five thebe to 215 thebe, Inco also up five thebe at 80 thebe, and Kgola Ya Sechaba up five thebe to 140 thebe.
Among the losers were First National which shed 20 thebe to 465 thebe and Sefalana, down 25 thebe to 420 thebe.
Nine of the 12 counters listed on the exchange traded. The three bid but not traded were Barclays, Engen and Pep.
Closing prices on Friday, November 29 were :

Barclays 440 thebe, Botswana Insurance 215, Engen 440, First National, Inco 80, Kgolo ya Sechaba 140, Metsef 650, Pep Holdings 260, Realestate Development 175, Schaba Trust 255, Sefalana Holdings 420, Standard Chartered 400 thebe.
